[[Nee Alavar/Legends|Nee Alavar]], [[Lorrdian/Legends|Lorrdian]] [[Senator/Legends|senator]] for the [[Kanz sector/Legends|Kanz sector]],<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|18|Alavar, Senator Nee}}</ref> possessed a '''family''' on her [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Lorrd/Legends|Lorrd]]. Due to Alavar's signing of the [[Petition of 2000]]<ref name="DITSPOL" /> which formally censured [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] for his policies as leader of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]],<ref name="CSWE" /> Alavar was [[Death/Legends|executed]] by the Republic's successor state, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]],<ref name="DITSPOL" /> around [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="Death date">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/fiction/feature20090531/index.html?page=1|text=Death in the Slave Pits of Lorrd: A Hyperspace Exclusive|int=Death in the Slave Pits of Lorrd}} states that Alavar was arrested and executed shortly after the creation of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].</ref> Subsequently, her family was deported to labor camps to set an example. Lorrdians who fought the Empire as members of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] typically left the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] to avoid their families suffering the same fate as Alavar.<ref name="DITSPOL" />

==Behind the scenes==
Nee Alavar's family was mentioned in "[[Death in the Slave Pits of Lorrd]]," an in-universe story exclusive to [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace: The Official ''Star Wars'' Fan Club]], written by [[Adrick Tolliver]] and released on [[June 1]], [[2009]].<ref name="DITSPOL" />
